run_GTestOutputTest: run the googletest output test to validate GTest program output against a golden file

test_RemoveStackTraceDetails: test the RemoveStackTraceDetails function to replace stack trace blocks with an omitted placeholder

test_ToUnixLineEnding: test the ToUnixLineEnding function to convert Windows and Mac line endings to UNIX format
